name: Pectins
aliases: E440, E440(i), E440(ii), INS 440, pectin, pectins, non-amidated pectin, amidated pectin, amidated pectins
what_is: A family of plant-derived polysaccharide gelling and stabilising agents, including non-amidated and amidated pectins, grouped under E440.
why_botia: Pectin is a natural fibre in fruit — one of the substances that makes jam set. As a food additive it is extracted mainly from citrus peel and apples. It is not absorbed intact: it reaches the large intestine and ferments there, so it acts as soluble fibre. JECFA did not see a need to set a numerical limit.
can_1: Detect E440, pectin, pectins and the common amidated/non-amidated subtype names.
can_2: Show the texture and E-number information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the exact pectin subtype or formulation when only 'pectin' is declared.
cannot_2: Calculate the amount present from ingredient order alone.
